title: Quote or lyric loop over generative art
summary: A quote or lyric arrives phrase by phrase in refined serif type over a slow generative backdrop (flow-field silk, bokeh dust or a soft mesh gradient), then the attribution; the backdrop is periodic so the clip loops.
needs: The exact quote and who said it, in the brief
Permission to publish the words (public domain, licence, or the speaker's approval)
gallery_share: Quote and lyric cards over ambient generative visuals are a staple of social feeds and of model-made short videos.
limits: Typeface is whatever system serif is installed (EB Garamond, Noto Serif, Georgia...), so line breaks can differ between machines
Latin scripts; very long words shrink the setting
At most 140 characters in a 15-second loop
The verbatim check accepts any exact span of the brief, so a reviewer must still confirm the quote is complete and correctly attributed
